    AskBookie_

    A polished, production ready frontend for a RAG chat app that lets students query academic documents via a conversational interface.

    Live DemoGitHubRAG model not supported in web version anymore
    ReactTypeScriptTailwind CSSFramer MotionRAGVite

    My Role

    I built the entire frontend from the chat UI, PDF upload flow, and subject selector to theming, animations, and responsive layout. The backend RAG pipeline and API architecture were designed and built by pmmdot, who also led the project.

    What I Built

    Chat Interface

    Real time conversational UI with streaming response rendering and message history.

    PDF Upload Flow

    Client side validation, progress tracking, and retry logic for document indexing.

    Subject Selector

    Physics, Chemistry, Python organized Q&A with subject based context switching.

    Theme & Responsive

    Dark and light toggle with persisted preference. Fully mobile first responsive design.
